title: Masters of Scale Summit (Presidio Theatre, SF) — Eric on 'a place for bold vision and the conviction to do what's right'
summary: Masters of Scale — Reid Hoffman's flagship 800-attendee, invite-only summit — books Eric on the Oct 20–22 stage at the Presidio Theatre in San Francisco. He joins Reid Hoffman, Eric Schmidt, Kara Swisher, Reed Hastings, Van Jones, Maria Ressa (Nobel Peace Laureate), Meredith Whittaker (Signal), Matthew Prince (Cloudflare), Dr. Toyin Ajayi (Cityblock), Amjad Masad (Replit), Anjali Sud (Tubi), Baratunde Thurston, and Ariel Ekblaw (Aurelia Institute). Masters of Scale's own announcement calls Eric out as 'Eric Ries, Author, Incorruptible.'
blockquote:
The Masters of Scale Summit stage is a place for bold vision and the conviction to do what's right.

This October, these leaders will show us what it means to build and fight for the future we all want to see. 

❇️ Eric Schmidt, Former Google
❇️ Maria Ressa, Nobel Prize Laureate
❇️ Baratunde Thurston, Life With Machines
❇️ Eric Ries, Author, Incorruptible
❇️ Ariel Ekblaw, Aurelia Institute

Alongside a lineup of the most iconic names in business.
